$comment: Sample data of the store captures (bipe-chat/bipe#457): one entry per slug of the `## Screenshots` table in appstore.md, read by the bipe-app capture sources (Android screenshotTest, iOS BipeStoreCaptures UI test). People and groups are cast ids (cast.json); `image` and `sticker` name the cast photo that a message shows. Message text is people's voice, so it is the same in both locales; the app's own text comes from the strings. tools/gen.mjs writes it into bipe-app android/app/src/screenshotTest; bipe-app tools/store-captures-ios.mjs reads it for iOS; tools/lib/store-captures.mjs checks it.
